g.text: crvUSD was already below peg before the ETH drop and fell to 0.9942
Block level spot price in the five PegKeeper pools. Weighted price 0.9979 at 20:00 UTC, lowest 0.9942 at 21:56 UTC,
still 0.9967 at 04:00. Below 0.997 for 6.1 of 8 hours. Lowest single pool print 0.9893 (pyUSD).
Source: Ethereum mainnet logs and archive state via public RPC. Window 2026-11-08 20:00 to 2026-11-09 04:00 UTC. Times in UTC. ETH/USD from Chainlink,
which updates on deviation or heartbeat. Paired stablecoins valued at 1 USD.
